001package com.streamconverter.command;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.io.OutputStream;
006import java.util.Objects;
007import org.apache.commons.io.input.TeeInputStream;
008
009/**
010 * Abstract class for commands that consume an input stream and produce an output stream.
011 *
012 * <p>This class provides a template method pattern for executing the command, ensuring that the
013 * input and output streams are not null. It also provides a method to consume the input stream,
014 * which must be implemented by subclasses.
015 */
016public abstract class ConsumerCommand implements IStreamCommand {
017
018  /**
019   * Default constructor.
020   *
021   * <p>Subclasses typically expose their own factory methods or constructors.
022   */
023  protected ConsumerCommand() {}
024
025  /**
026   * Executes the command on the provided input stream and writes the result to the output stream.
027   *
028   * <p><strong>Note on data integrity:</strong> This method uses {@link TeeInputStream} to copy
029   * input bytes to {@code outputStream} as they are read by {@link #consume(InputStream)}. If
030   * {@code consume()} throws an exception, partial data may already have been written to {@code
031   * outputStream}. To prevent this, place a {@link
032   * com.streamconverter.command.impl.FileBufferCommand} immediately before this command in the
033   * pipeline:
034   *
035   * <pre>{@code
036   * StreamConverter.create(
037   *     new MyValidateCommand(),
038   *     FileBufferCommand.create(),
039   *     new MyConsumerCommand()  // ConsumerCommand subclass
040   * );
041   * }</pre>
042   *
043   * @param inputStream The input stream to read data from.
044   * @param outputStream The output stream to write data to.
045   * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs during the execution of the command.
046   */
047  @Override
048  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
049    Objects.requireNonNull(inputStream);
050    Objects.requireNonNull(outputStream);
051
052    try (InputStream teeInputStream = new TeeInputStream(inputStream, outputStream)) {
053      this.consume(teeInputStream);
054    } catch (IOException e) {
055      throw new IOException("Error while consuming input stream", e);
056    }
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for consuming the input stream.
061   *
062   * @param inputStream The input stream to read data from.
063   * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs during the execution of the command.
064   */
065  public abstract void consume(InputStream inputStream) throws IOException;
066}
